entities.summary: Khizri Magomedovich Abakarov is a Russian statesman, public figure, and entrepreneur. Since 19 September 2021, he has been a Deputy of the State Duma of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation of the 8th convocation, representing the United Russia party.
